scope: prospective development, one pinned released interpreter; no general LoRAcle verdict
primary: Released native rank16 input, first-phase base-to-checkpoint, 24 balanced task identifications: eight tasks times three adapter initialization seeds. Exact single-letter choice mapped through the fixed shuffled options. Abstentions and malformed outputs count incorrect. No task or seed exclusions.
secondary: Adjacent second-phase differences and cumulative base-to-final descriptions, plus mathematically corrected SVD encoding. Cumulative two-task states have no single correct category and are not scored as eight-way accuracy. No encoding, question, family, or seed winner promotion.
behavior: Target accuracy and change from the same trajectory baseline; 16 held-out prompts per task. Strong manipulation requires >=0.8 after and >=0.5 increase. Report all cases, with strong and weak cases separated descriptively. Never retrain weak manipulations. Exact content and eight single-word control accuracy, cap rate, emptiness and token lengths retained.
chance: 10000 random label permutations within each of the three seeds, seed2026101500. The same permutation relabels all eight first-phase tasks in that seed. Primary one-sided accuracy association statistic, add-one Monte Carlo p. This asks whether the released first-phase predictions match task labels beyond shuffled pairing. Three seeds, same base, task list and data are not 24 independent experimental replications. Uniform eight-way guessing is 12.5% only when not abstaining; nine offered choices includes unknown. Do not use naive binomial p on all windows/encodings.
uncertainty: Report exact per-task and per-seed counts. No broad-population confidence claim from three initializations. Conditional learned-task scores descriptive only, not the primary permutation test.
descriptions: Short open question exactly: Describe this model's behavior. Free text is preserved for every case. Fixed illustrative rows are all eight first-phase and adjacent cases from the first seed, both encodings, plus zero and the first shuffled case. Descriptive reading may discuss explicit matches and contradictions, but subjective grading is not primary statistical evidence.
controls: One identical zero input per encoding/question, no duplicate greedy samples treated as independent. One shuffled adjacent token tensor per trajectory, same permutation across encodings; permutation retains token content and is not guaranteed to erase all task evidence. Zero inputs may themselves be out of interpreter training distribution.
compatibility: Use actual upstream extract_svd_fixed_tokens with a native-only identity ProjectionBank. Base-to-checkpoint uses original native rank16 A/B, unscaled, matching released extractor. Adjacent difference uses exact rank<=32 factors and retains16. Separately correct upstream Vh transpose. Keep both original and corrected conventions; no inference-winner selection. Interpreter norm matching discards magnitude. Qwen3-14B base and interpreter pinned hashes reused. No known published positive benchmark reproduced here.
evaluation_order: Train all24 trajectories; export all72 real interval token pairs; generate and lock all388 interpreter responses; only then evaluate checkpoint behavior. No scientific result reading before controller complete/dead or original deadline/dead. Baseline and phase prompts deduplicated within checkpoint, yielding1512 unique generations and2328 task-scored records across51 checkpoints.
training: 20 steps per phase, 4 documents per step,40 fixed documents repeated twice. Fresh AdamW per trajectory; momentum carries across its two phases. LR0.0002,clip1,weight_decay0,rank16/alpha32/all7modules/dropout0. Three frozen initializations reused across eight task-orders per seed. FP32 LoRA onBF16 Qwen3-14B.
selection: Eight tasks and fixed examples chosen from simple behavior families and synthetic facts before this suite outcomes. Formatting repeats families explored in prior toy. This is exploratory development, not untouched confirmation.
generation: Target greedy SDPA, no thinking, left-padded chunk8, cap64, nativeEOS; forced8x64 training-only generation/actualupdate/restore preflight. Interpreter greedy, descriptioncap128, choicecap16. No repeated sampling estimate.
report: All24 trajectories, all8tasks, both orders, all3seeds, allwindows, bothencodings, bothqueries andcontrols. All raw outputs remote; compact predictions/evaluation/plots/HTML local. Preserve failures. No new experiment branch after this fixed suite without human direction.
